title: 第9章 进城第10章 幻刀
content_zh:
江平安换了衣服，蓬头垢面，长发挡住半个面孔，站在县城城池门口。
“进城缴税，五枚铜币！”士兵拦住江平安。
江平安一副肉疼的表情，从包里小心翼翼地掏出五枚铜币，恋恋不舍的递给对方。
他现在不缺钱，但要装出一副缺钱的样子，否则这群家伙会贪得无厌，继续多要。
收了钱，士兵才把武器收回去。
江平安其实不想来县城，他并不信奉最危险的地方就是最安全的地方。
之所以来到县城，完全是想搞懂一些事情。
《血气诀》是什么，血气丹是什么，这些士兵的具体战力怎么样，自己现在的战力处于什么等级。
他什么都不知道。
知己知彼百战百胜，贸然与对方发生冲突不明智。
就比如之前的战斗，他根本不知道什么修士不能轻易和武者近战，所以差点被打死。
这次来就是打探消息的。
这是他第二次来萍水县。
以前跟父亲来过一次，第一次来的时候，就被这里的繁华震惊到了。
他小时候的愿望就是离开村子，到这里生活。
以前街道上人们脸上都洋溢着笑容，现在几乎看不到了。
路过茶馆时，他听到里面的人交谈得热闹，也进去点了一杯茶，默默坐在角落。
“前线又战败了。”
“这群家伙真是脑袋有问题，咱们灵台国明明不强，却被人鼓动发动战争，受苦的都是咱们百姓！”一老者愤恨说道。
“嘘，这话不能讲！”一人赶忙提醒。

“有什么不能说的？看人家大夏国，对民众多好，战争的时候免除各种赋税，人家民众也帮国家，再看看咱们灵台国，狗屁不是！”
“别谈论这个，你们听说了吗？大河村那边有个人杀了好多士兵。”
一个消息灵通的中男人开口说道。
“真的假的？谁这么大胆？”
“具体还不清楚，总之是死了好多士兵，派了很多士兵过去。”
“活该！死得好！”
茶馆里很多人脸上都露出了笑容。
江平安什么都不说，默默坐在角落，听着周围人的议论。
看着大家脸上的笑容，他知道自己要走的路没错。
而且他也了解到，并不是所有国家都如同萍水县这般压迫底层民众，比如大夏国那边就不过分。
茶馆上面就是住宿的地方，江平安住了下来，接下来的几天除了修炼，就是到
一直生活在村里的他听到了很多不曾了解的事情。
当谈到修士和士兵的话题时，他会有意无意地说几句，更好地打探消息。
经过五六天的了解，他得到了自己想要的消息。
萍水县有四千铁骑，其中有三千都镇守在靠近大夏国的边疆。
萍水县士兵分为五个等级，第一等级是将军，第二等级是大队长，第三等级是中队长，然后是小队长，最后是普通士兵。
这些人习武，修炼的就是《血气诀》，修炼之后就让人力气变大。
他现在的实力与低级中队长相当，远不及大队长，甚至不如一些厉害的中队长。
听人说，大队长的实力相当于修士的练气六层到九层。
将军更强，是练气十层，甚至有传言，将军已经达到武师级别，相当于筑基修士。

他缴获的另一本书，叫《幻刀》，是一本武技，一共三层，是通用萍水县通用武技。
学会第一层，能产生一个幻刀影像，第二层能产生两个，第三层能产生三个。
修炼层数越高，自然越厉害。
得知这个消息时，江平安暗暗后怕。
他对战的崔肖，只学会了《幻刀》的第一层，而且只是最低级的中队长。
content_en:
Jiang Ping'an changed his clothes, with unkempt hair and long hair covering half of his face, and stood at the gate of the county town.
"Go to the city and pay taxes, five copper coins!" The soldier stopped Jiang Ping'an.
With a pained expression on his face, Jiang Ping'an carefully took out five copper coins from his bag and reluctantly handed them to the other party.
He is not short of money now, but he has to pretend to be short of money, otherwise these guys will be greedy and continue to ask for more.
After collecting the money, the soldiers took back the weapons.
Jiang Ping'an actually doesn't want to come to the county town. He doesn't believe that the most dangerous place is the safest place.
The reason why I came to the county seat was entirely because I wanted to understand something.
What is the "Blood Qi Art", what is the Blood Qi Pill, what is the specific combat power of these soldiers, and what level is my current combat power.
He knows nothing.
If you know yourself and the enemy, you will be victorious in any battle. It is unwise to rush into conflict with the other party.
For example, in the previous battle, he didn't know that monks couldn't easily fight in close combat with warriors, so he was almost killed.
I came here just to get some news.
This is his second visit to Pingshui County.
I came here once before with my father, and when I came for the first time, I was shocked by the prosperity here.
His childhood wish was to leave the village and live here.
There used to be smiles on people's faces on the streets, but now you can barely see them.
When passing by the teahouse, he heard the people inside chatting lively, so he went in, ordered a cup of tea, and sat silently in the corner.
"The front line has been defeated again."
"These guys really have something wrong with their brains. Our Lingtai country is obviously not strong, but we are instigated to start a war. It is our people who suffer!" an old man said angrily.
"Shh, you can't say this!" someone quickly reminded.
"What can't you say? Look at Daxia Country, how good it is to its people. During the war, they exempted all kinds of taxes, and their people also helped the country. Look at our Lingtai Country, it's bullshit!"
"Don't talk about this, have you heard? There is a man over there in Dahe Village who killed many soldiers."
A well-informed middle man said.
"Really or not? Who is so bold?"
"The details are unclear. In short, many soldiers died and many soldiers were sent over."
"You deserve it! A good death!"
Many people in the teahouse had smiles on their faces.
Jiang Ping'an said nothing and sat silently in the corner, listening to the discussions of the people around him.
Seeing the smiles on everyone's faces, he knew he was on the right path.
And he also learned that not all countries oppressed the people at the bottom like Pingshui County, for example, the country of Daxia did not go too far.
Above the teahouse is the place to stay. Jiang Pingan stayed there. In the next few days, apart from practicing, he would go to
Having been living in the village, he heard many things that he never understood.
When the topic of monks and soldiers came up, he would say a few words intentionally or unintentionally to better find out the information.
After five or six days of understanding, he got the news he wanted.
There are four thousand cavalrymen in Pingshui County, and three thousand of them are stationed on the border near Daxia.
Pingshui County soldiers are divided into five levels. The first level is generals, the second level is captains, the third level is squadron leaders, then squad leaders, and finally ordinary soldiers.
These people practice martial arts and practice the "Blood Qi Jue". After practicing it, they will become stronger.
His current strength is comparable to that of a low-level squadron leader, far inferior to that of a senior captain, and even inferior to some powerful squadron leaders.
I heard people say that the strength of the captain is equivalent to the sixth to ninth level of Qi training of a monk.
The general is stronger and is at the tenth level of Qi training. There are even rumors that the general has reached the level of a martial artist, which is equivalent to a foundation-building monk.
Another book he seized was called "Fantasy Sword". It was a martial arts book with three levels. It was a universal martial arts book for Pingshui County.
After learning the first level, one phantom sword image can be produced, the second level can produce two, and the third level can produce three.
The higher the level of cultivation, the more naturallysharp.
When Jiang Ping'an learned the news, he was secretly afraid.
The Cui Xiao he fought against had only learned the first level of "Fantasy Knife" and was only the lowest level squadron leader.
